note: The counterpart to accept/inline-endpoint-within-tolerance.vnx: the same arc, the same shape, an inline endpoint 55 m away instead of 45 m. SPEC 3.3.3 makes an endpoint that does not project within tolerance an unusable value, and SPEC 6.2's remedy is to drop the LINK - not the endpoint, which would leave a malformed link, and not the chain, which would be disproportionate. The expected message deliberately does NOT include the measured distance: the number a reader reports depends on its distance model, and pinning it would make this case fail for a conforming implementation whose arithmetic differs in the last metre. What is pinned is that the endpoint was refused and the tolerance named.
